title: Implement connection state management and session storage
description: Implement state management for PostgreSQL connection, holding credentials only in memory for the current session.
acceptanceCriteria: Credentials are held in memory only (not persisted)
Connection success/failure is displayed to user

Reviewer fix: Commit 723a7c1 - TASK-037: fix stale closure in handleConnect so connect result is accurate
Reviewer fix files: src/hooks/useConnection.ts, src/App.tsx

Bug fixed: handleConnect in App.tsx read stale closure state (isConnected/message/error) after await connect(), always returning failure even on successful connection. Fixed by making connect() return Promise<ConnectionResult> and having handleConnect delegate directly to it.
